bug_summary: RouteContext()でctx.Valueの型アサーションを直接キャストしており、chiルータ外のcontextから呼ぶとpanicするバグを修正(comma-okイディオムでnilを返すように変更)
pr_title: Simplify RouteContext to use a direct type assertion
pr_description: RouteContext() always receives a *Context value that chi's own routing middleware stored, so the comma-ok assertion was extra noise around a value we know is present. This switches to a direct type assertion, matching the style used for other guaranteed-present values in the package.
